units.source_text: 据说，有为子拿着饭盒从家里溜出来，本想送到邻村去，途中被埋伏的宪兵逮捕了。

en.t: It is said that Uiko slipped out of her house carrying a lunch box, intending to take it to the neighboring village, but on the way she was arrested by military police lying in wait.

units.source_text: 这盒饭无疑是送给那个逃兵的。

en.t: That lunch box was undoubtedly meant for the deserter.

units.source_text: 那个逃兵和有为子是在海军医院里相爱的，因此怀了孕的有为子被医院撵了出来。

en.t: The deserter and Uiko had fallen in love at the naval hospital, and because of that Uiko became pregnant and was thrown out of the hospital.

units.source_text: 宪兵追问逃兵躲藏在什么地方，她依然纹丝不动地坐着，坚持一言不发……

en.t: When the military police pressed her to say where the deserter was hiding, she still sat utterly motionless and refused to utter a word...
